purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Equipment Relink details.
features: Equipment Relink Function is used to Re-Link container to Booking, if the container is not linked properly.

events.description: Re-links the container to the booking. Message: "Selected PR relinked successfully"
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Equipment Relink from the single function menu
